array.string: mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Logs/bach"; cd "$HOME/services/bach/system" || exit 1; export PATH="$HOME/.venvs/bach/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" PYTHONPATH="$HOME/services/bach/system"; exec "$HOME/.venvs/bach/bin/python" hub/_services/chat/chat_tray.py --port 8081 >>"$HOME/Library/Logs/bach/chat-tray.log" 2>>"$HOME/Library/Logs/bach/chat-tray.err.log"
